title: Where to find open calls: 10 sites compared
seoTitle: Where to find open calls for artists and writers (2026)
description: Ten places artists and writers find open calls, grants and residencies, compared on price, fees shown, no-fee filters, deadline reminders and tracking.
summary: Ten sites for finding open calls, from ArtConnect to Chill Subs, compared on price, fees shown, no-fee filters, reminders and tracking.
primaryKeyword: where to find open calls for artists
answer: For visual art calls, start with CaFÉ, ArtConnect or CuratorSpace. For literary magazines, try Poets & Writers or Chill Subs. For calls across art forms, try NYFA or Missa. Wherever you look, check who can apply and the full cost on the organizer's page. A free search account doesn't make an exhibition free.
keyPoints: Pick a site by what you make: art calls, magazine databases, or both.
CuratorSpace, CaFÉ, Artenda and Missa can email you before a saved call closes.
A no-fee filter covers applying, not shipping, travel or the cost of taking part.
